products.label: Cosmicflows-4 galaxies by type
products.process: Place every CF4 galaxy between 3 and 200 Mpc at its measured distance; colour it by its HyperLEDA type through the Kinney-Calzetti template of that type (CIE 1931 into sRGB).
limitations: The templates are spectra of galaxy centres, not whole-galaxy light; types later than Sc take the Sc template.
A galaxy with no HyperLEDA type is drawn white.

products.label: Local Group galaxies
products.process: Place each LVDB galaxy at its adopted distance; tone it by its absolute V magnitude.
limitations: The templates are spectra of galaxy centres, not whole-galaxy light; types later than Sc take the Sc template.
A galaxy with no HyperLEDA type is drawn white.

products.label: Galaxy dots, 200 Mpc level
products.process: Keep galaxies, in a fixed shuffle, while the ones within the kernel stay under the level's even density; nested levels add only galaxies the enclosing levels do not draw.
limitations: An even density is a presentation choice: real concentrations above it are thinned; sparser regions, as the zone the Milky Way's disc hides, are the catalogue's gaps, not voids.

products.label: Galaxy dots, Local Volume level
products.process: Every LVDB galaxy nearer than Cosmicflows-4's nearest galaxy (3.03 Mpc), unthinned: the innermost level.
limitations: An even density is a presentation choice: real concentrations above it are thinned; sparser regions, as the zone the Milky Way's disc hides, are the catalogue's gaps, not voids.

products.label: Galaxy dots at every zoom
products.process: Join the five levels, outermost first, into one bank the app draws as a growing prefix: the field whole within 100 Mpc, each inner level's galaxies one at a time as the view narrows past its radius, the Local Volume galaxies last.
limitations: The appearance windows are presentation choices.

products.label: DESI bright galaxies
products.process: Place each galaxy at its comoving distance in the Planck 2018 cosmology; colour it from its g, r, z fluxes as the Legacy Surveys draw them; tone it by its r magnitude.
limitations: Presentation choices (shares, reach, colour mapping and tone) are recorded with their basis in each recipe.

products.label: DESI quasars
products.process: Place each quasar at its comoving distance in the Planck 2018 cosmology; colour it by the composite quasar spectrum stretched to its redshift.
limitations: Presentation choices (shares, reach, colour mapping and tone) are recorded with their basis in each recipe.

limitations: Presentation choices (shares, reach, colour mapping and tone) are recorded with their basis in each recipe.

products.label: Quasar dots
